check_method.numeric_rows: Require finite numeric conversion for OHLC, TICKVOL, VOL, and SPREAD columns; report rows with any missing/non-numeric value.
check_method.ohlc_order: Require HIGH >= LOW, OPEN, CLOSE and LOW <= OPEN, CLOSE.
check_method.row_roles: Train rows have date <= 2025-12-31; exposed rows have date >= 2026-01-01.
check_method.timestamp: Parse tab-separated <DATE>/<TIME> with %Y.%m.%d %H:%M:%S; timestamps remain naive broker-clock values.
check_method.timestamp_gaps: Count adjacent source-order deltas above 60, 300, and 3600 seconds; do not classify them as missing bars without an authoritative market schedule.
check_method.training_ny_session_observation: Under the configured Etc/GMT-3 to America/Chicago conversion, count observed M1 rows in each [08:30:00, 15:00:00) session and check the nominal final bar. Do not label deviations as missing bars or closures without a calendar.

configuration.bar_source: M1 CSV files; higher bar timeframes are resampled by the pipeline
configuration.recorded_timezone_assumption: Etc/GMT-3 from quant_rl/config/default.yaml; timestamps in files are timezone-naive broker-clock strings

data_role: training through 2025-12-31; 2026-01-01 through 2026-07-03 is previously inspected/exposed development data
evidence_role: bounded data-quality inventory; not proof of data rights, vendor authenticity, strategy validity, or confirmatory OOS evidence
g1_status: PARTIAL; this scan covers basic M1 integrity and identity fingerprints only.

interpretation.timestamp_gap_counts: Elapsed discontinuities include expected market closures and holidays; they are not classified as missing bars without an authoritative trading-calendar schedule.
interpretation.zero_volume: MT5 CFD bar exports record VOL=0; tick volume is the activity field. This is not real traded volume.

training_ny_session_observation.interpretation: Observed rows under the configured Etc/GMT-3 to America/Chicago conversion. Counts are compared with a nominal 390-minute window, but short sessions are not classified as missing bars or market closures without an authoritative calendar.

open_g1_items: Vendor/feed identity, export provenance, and applicable data-use/license terms are not established by the CSVs or repository metadata inspected here.
Tick input hashes are recorded in the active campaign manifest but tick-file content/quality was not rescanned in this audit.
Timestamp discontinuities are not compared against an authoritative exchange/broker calendar; they are not asserted to be missing bars.
The fixed Etc/GMT-3 convention is an assumption; source broker timezone and broker DST schedule are not independently verified. Session/DST impact must be treated as a validity limitation.

This scan does not revalidate feature causality/prefix invariance, fold-local fitting, purged walk-forward masks, MTF close/confirmation alignment, or strict cache hash behavior; retain their separate evidence and review them against current sources.
The terminal recovery campaign lacks current-attempt full-split episode telemetry for ladder_a0_flat; terminal campaign state alone does not establish full-split exposure.
